name: product-on-steroids
description: Product-management best-practice skills for Claude Code — 5 plugins on the Peak Product Manager quadrants: discovery, strategy, go-to-market, execution, and influence.

plugins.name: pm-strategy
plugins.description: Product strategy skills: outcomes ownership, vision & roadmap, and strategic impact (market sizing, competitive analysis, positioning, macro frameworks).

plugins.name: pm-discovery
plugins.description: Customer insight skills: interviews & synthesis, opportunity-solution trees, assumptions & experiments, personas, journeys, segmentation, and analytics.

plugins.name: pm-gtm
plugins.description: Go-to-market skills: GTM strategy & motions, ICP & beachhead, positioning, growth loops, battlecards, and launch artifacts.

plugins.name: pm-execution
plugins.description: Product execution skills: PRDs, user stories, story mapping & splitting, sprint planning, pre-mortems, retros, and test scenarios.

plugins.name: pm-influence
plugins.description: Influencing-people skills: managing up, stakeholder management, and team leadership — exec updates, decision memos, alignment narratives, escalation.
